args.code: (function() { try { var els = document.querySelectorAll('[class]'); var out = {}; for (var i = 0; i < els.length && i < 100; i++) { var cls = els[i].className; if (cls && (cls.indexOf('day') >= 0 || cls.indexOf('season') >= 0 || cls.indexOf('money') >= 0 || cls.indexOf('stamina') >= 0 || cls.indexOf('health') >= 0 || cls.indexOf('weather') >= 0)) { out[cls] = els[i].textContent; } } var allText = document.body.innerText.split('\n').slice(0,30); return {found: out, textLines: allText}; } catch(e) { return {error: e.message}; } })()
